items.title: North Korea drops reunification from constitution, codifies Kim's nuclear authority

featured_image.name: North Korea removes reunification from its constitution

items.description:
North Korea has revised its constitution to remove all references to reunification with South Korea, formally codifying leader Kim Jong Un's doctrine of treating the two Koreas as hostile, separate states, according to a draft of the amended text reviewed by Reuters.[1][2]

The revision, believed to have been adopted during a March session of the Supreme People's Assembly, marks the first time North Korea has included a territorial clause in its constitution, Seoul National University professor Lee Jung-chul said at a South Korean Unification Ministry briefing on Wednesday.[3][4]

items.title: French container ship hit by missile in Strait of Hormuz

featured_image.name: CMA CGM Vessel Navigates Hormuz as Crisis Remains 'Localized'

items.description:
French shipping giant CMA CGM confirmed on Wednesday that its Maltese-flagged container vessel, the CMA CGM San Antonio, was struck during an attack while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, injuring several crew members and damaging the ship.[1][2]

U.S. officials told CBS News the vessel was hit by what they described as a possible land-attack cruise missile late Tuesday evening local time, with several Filipino crew members among the injured. The wounded were evacuated and are receiving medical treatment, the company said in a statement to AFP.[3][4][1]

items.title: China's Big Fund in talks to lead DeepSeek round at $45B valuation

featured_image.name: China's DeepSeek is raising funds at $10 billion valuation ...

items.description:
China's largest state-backed semiconductor investment vehicle is in advanced negotiations to lead the first external funding round for AI startup DeepSeek at a valuation of approximately $45 billion, the Financial Times reported on Tuesday, citing four people familiar with the discussions.[1][2]

The China Integrated Circuit Industry Investment Fund — known in the industry as the "Big Fund" — would mark a dramatic expansion of its mandate, which has historically focused on chip fabrication, memory producers, and semiconductor equipment rather than AI model labs.[3][1]

items.title: Trump pauses Iran strikes, warns of escalation if no deal

featured_image.name: Trump extends pause on strikes against Iran's energy infrastructure

items.description: Iran confirmed on Wednesday that it is formally evaluating a US peace proposal as the two sides inch toward what a Pakistani mediator has described as a potential agreement to end the nearly 10-week war. President Donald Trump announced a temporary pause of "Project Freedom," the US military operation to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, citing "great progress" toward a deal — but warned that bombing would resume "at a much higher level and intensity" if Tehran refuses to come to terms.[1][2][3]

items.title: Spain to repatriate all passengers from hantavirus cruise ship

featured_image.name: M/V Hondius - Reef and Rainforest Tours

items.description: All passengers and crew remaining aboard the MV Hondius, a luxury expedition cruise ship struck by a deadly hantavirus outbreak, are currently asymptomatic, Spanish Health Minister Mónica García announced on Wednesday. The ship, which has been anchored near Cape Verde after being denied permission to dock, will now proceed to the Port of Granadilla in southern Tenerife, where passengers will be repatriated to their home countries.[1]
